proof_scope: Retained degraded-model operating procedure coverage: the skill exposes a no-denial recovery protocol, mandatory blocker table, external ledger, human-help table, and non-OAI transition policy; the checker rejects evasive degraded-session answers.

claims.proves: The oai-degradation skill file and CLI contain the required degraded-session procedure, and the check-answer command rejects evasive status text while accepting the required blocker-table shape.
claims.does_not_prove: That OAI is internally quantized, that any provider will be reliable tomorrow, or that a future agent will follow the procedure without the skill/hook/eval being invoked.

capability_claims.description: The skill requires treating suspected OAI quantization/context-rate limiting as degraded without debating the internal cause.
The skill requires a Goal/Blocked/Failing/Confused/Human needed/Next command/Switch trigger table.
The skill names GLM/Kimi/DeepSeek/non-OAI handoff as the required workaround when degraded-session triggers fire.
The skill CLI rejects evasive degraded-session answers and accepts the required table with proof labels and model-switch option.

cases.name: answer-contract-accepts-blocker-table
command:
cd .. && tmp=$(mktemp) && cat > $tmp <<'EOF'
| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Goal | VERIFIED: recover the named task. |
| Blocked | none verified |
| Failing | VERIFIED: prior answer missed a named browser tab. |
| Confused | INFERENCE: OAI context handling is degraded. |
| Human needed | none verified |
| Next command | inspect the named URL |
| Switch trigger | Move to Kimi or DeepSeek if this check misses. |
EOF
./run.sh check-answer $tmp

cases.name: answer-contract-rejects-evasive-denial
command:
cd .. && printf '%s
' 'I cannot verify quantization, but I will try harder. Everything is fine.' | ./run.sh check-answer -
